messages:
carmen: Quick sync  EmeraldLake interview wrapped. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/emeraldlake. Need: transcript redlines, quote approval, embargo timing, webinar slot + deck stat, captions/localization, and lead-routing tags.

finn: Heard ite28082a6 they used a line that sounds like a raw metric ("p95 dropped from X to Y"). Legal will probably want that sanitized.

marie: Yep - prefer paraphrase: "significantly reduced inference latency and cost" or "cut inference costs by ~50%". Also: can we get a 30s hero clip for social + 4 webinar soundbites? I can edit captions for EN/ES but need raw clips by EOD. :clock530:

legal-bot: Automated check: NDA present, release form uploaded. Recommend redacting internal IDs, request hashes, and any hostnames. Public quote must use rounded language; avoid absolute telemetry. Use `customer-release-v2` template and obtain explicit written approval on final copy.

carmen: Copy that. @finn can you propose two quote options to send to the customer for sign-off? One verbatim (for internal) and one public-safe paraphrase.

finn: Sure. Drafts: 1) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% while improving median latency." 2) "We saw a meaningful drop in inference cost and faster response times after moving to Redwood." Which should I send?

marie: Send both, ask them to OK public wording. Also flag localization: need DE/FR captions - can ops help with vendor pick?

ops-bot: Vendor options: TranscribeNow (fast, auto-translate), LocalizePro (better accuracy, slower). ETA: TranscribeNow 24h, LocalizePro 72h. Ops recommends TranscribeNow for launch.

legal-bot: Note: if customer requests exact percentages or absolute latency numbers in the public quote, we require an internal telemetry disclosure and an additional signed clause. Prefer the paraphrase option.

carmen: Good to know. Embargo proposal: 2026-04-15 11:00 PT. Sound ok?

finn: Works for product/webinar schedule. I'll slot the webinar follow-up on 2026-04-22 to deep-dive the benchmark. Need a slide with a safe phrasing stat.

marie: I'll cut the social hero + 4x 15s webinar clips and upload to Drive. Tagging: add utm_campaign=emeraldlake_launch, utm_source=social, utm_medium=twitter. Also want `lead_tag=benchmark-interest` and route demos to AE Nora (nora@redwood.ai).

ops-bot: Adding tracking pixel and HubSpot flow. Example UTM snippet: 
```
https://redwood.ai/emeraldlake?utm_campaign=emeraldlake_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social
```
Routing rule: if lead includes `benchmark-interest` tag -> assign to Nora, priority: high-touch.

finn: Sending customer two quote options now. I'll BCC Carmen and Legal. ETA for customer sign-off: 48h.

legal-bot: Please attach the redlined transcript to the release form. Legal will mark green after we receive final signed approval on the public quote.

carmen: Timeline recap: Finn sends quotes (now), customer reply within 48h, Marie uploads clips + captions by EOD today, Ops sets pixel + HubSpot flow by EOD tomorrow, embargo lifts 2026-04-15 11:00 PT pending legal final sign-off.

marie: Uploading clips to Drive shortly and will ping here when done. :rocket:

finn: Customer replied - approved public paraphrase: "reduced our inference costs by ~50%". They signed the release form. Forwarding signed PDF to Legal.

legal-bot: Received signed release. Final requirement: sign-off on redlined transcript. Schedule 15-min review if needed.

carmen: Thanks! Once transcript sign-off is done, Ops - please schedule the landing page publish and push to social at embargo time.

ops-bot: Will publish landing page and trigger social queue at 2026-04-15 11:00 PT. HubSpot flow and pixel live. Routing rules tested.

marie: Clips + captions uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/emeraldlake/assets. Shortcuts: social hero (30s), 4x 15s webinar moments, EN/ES captions.

finn: Redlined transcript uploaded. Legal - over to you.

legal-bot: Transcript reviewed and approved. All legal checks green. Embargo cleared.

carmen: Beautiful. Thanks team  Launch checklist complete. I'll follow up with the customer on publish day and capture any press/action items.
